design: Deterministic hash-ranked simple random sample of 200 training records per source; equal inclusion probability within source. Development and test texts are not inspected. Seed fixed before reading.
interpretation: minor remains readable and usable with imperfections; fail is excluded. Sample compliance is not a population guarantee or factual verification. Only observed failures and defensibly linked families are excluded; no extrapolated counts.
early_rejection_rule: For FineWeb, before opening any sample text: stop once >10 failures (including major) or >4 major corruption/boilerplate failures occur within the fixed 200-record sample. Even if every unread record passed, the source would fail the predeclared gate. No early acceptance. Unread records have no judgments; report reviewed denominator, no pass-rate extrapolation.
source_failure_action: Quarantine the entire source from the admitted pool when gate failure is mathematically established. Preserve mechanically eligible counts separately; this is not a claim every quarantined document is bad.

label_meaning.pass: Readable complete useful prose; no material issue noted, not factual certification
label_meaning.minor: Usable for narrow language experiment despite recorded imperfections or concerns
label_meaning.fail: Substantive coherence, completeness, extraction or epistemic-quality defect
label_meaning.major: Major semantic/grammatical corruption or dominant off-topic/template/link boilerplate; also a failure
